description: Current retail fuel prices for all API-supported countries. Covers gasoline, diesel, LPG, CNG, E85, kerosene and grade variants. Pass country_code to get one country in detail; omit it for a summary list.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE. If omitted, returns all countries.
